ns2:course.label: Independent Study I
ns2:course.description: Supervised independent study, research, or special project in a selected area related to landscape architecture. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Junior or senior standing, or consent of instructor. Consent of instructor prior to registration.
